results.text: Impact of a Terahertz electromagnetic field on the ion permeation of potassium and sodium channels. Ion channels are essential for various physiological processes, and their defects are associated with many diseases. Previous research has revealed that a Terahertz electromagnetic field can alter the channel conductance by affecting the motion of chemical groups of ion channels, and hence regulate the electric signals of neurons.
